checks: The agenda leads with the next due schedule and adjacent evidence; queued, failed and legacy states remain distinct, and selection makes no mutation.
Search, selection and edit drafts survive navigation; removing a project pin requires explicit fan-out intent, deletion stays confirmed, and a pending pause cannot repeat.
The inline composer renders the cron preview response, retains failed and pending drafts, and saves only on explicit submission.
History and list failures have explicit recovery; stale records disable mutations. Scheduler ticks and background setup occur only on their named actions.
Both themes fit 960/720 windows, reduced motion disables the reader reveal, and confirmed emptiness has its own creation path.
provenance: Actual renderer with synthetic schedules; no real scheduler tick, agent launch, provider call or daemon change
